sources.rationale: Conservative 2-layer FR-4, 1.6 mm finished stack, 35 um copper. Signals use 0.3 mm tracks; power uses 0.4 and 0.6 mm. Vias are 0.6/0.3 mm. This is an exact preserve import of KiCad 10.0.8-routed and checked copper. No fabrication quote or order; native ERC, DRC and parity receipts are in the same package.
